description.ja: 挨拶、呼び方、仕事、旅先、休日、隣の席、連絡先など、初対面のさまざまな場面で使う表現。
description.en: Expressions for different first meetings: introductions, names, work, travel, free time, sitting nearby and exchanging contact details.

rights.ja: このサイトのためにAIを用いて作成した例文。既存の教材からの転載ではありません。
rights.en: Examples created with AI for this site, not reproduced from existing teaching materials.

editorialNote.ja: 挨拶、呼び方、仕事、旅先、休日、隣の席、連絡先など、初対面のさまざまな場面で使う表現。 各小見出しは独立した場面です。短い掛け合いと単独で使える表現を組み合わせており、記事全体が一続きの会話ではありません。本文と読み表記を収録し、音声は未生成です。専門家による校閲は受けていません。
editorialNote.en: Expressions for different first meetings: introductions, names, work, travel, free time, sitting nearby and exchanging contact details. Each heading introduces an independent situation. Short exchanges are mixed with standalone expressions; the article is not one continuous conversation. Text and pronunciation readings are included; audio has not been generated. These examples have not been reviewed by specialists.
